Mission Local reported that the Mission Economic Development Agency (MEDA) was under contract to buy the 1914 brick building at 2901 16th St., two blocks from 16th Street BART, and planned to rehabilitate it into 62 permanent affordable homes. Existing tenants could stay or move out during the work; the ground-floor businesses would remain. The purchase depended on city loan approval, and MEDA was aiming to close by September 2024.
